results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued April 29, 2026
Fed's Interest Rate Decision: April 29, 2026 - dshort - Advisor Perspectives
US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board
What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?

summary: Fed held rates at 3.5%-3.75% at April 29, 2026 FOMC meeting (Powell's likely final as Chair). 8-4 vote; 3 dissents wanted to remove cut reference, 1 (Trump appointee Miran) wanted immediate cut — most dissents since 1992. Markets pricing in no changes through 2027. Inflation elevated partly from energy price surge.
